title: Preston Mill, East Linton
geometryBasis: The mapped mill and kiln are joined by the covered passage. Their footprint, May 2008 photographs and listed-building description fix the rubble walls, leaning kiln, red pantiles, covered connector, and wheel over the southern mill lade.
sectionBasis: The photographed conical kiln and rectangular mill use original terrain registration at the east-side path. The wheel is modeled at the documented approximately eleven-foot diameter and the lade follows the mapped drain immediately below.
limitations: Spring 2008 exterior. The wheel and sluice are static. The visitor building, nearby millpond and separate doocot are outside the model.
Roof pitch, detailed rubble, kiln lean, sill elevations and the lade section are approximate where the photographs and mapped outlines leave gaps.
Original terrain samples remain unchanged. A small ground opening follows the wheel channel beneath the modeled section of mill lade.
